jython:import re

# Standardize spelling and capitalization
value = value.lower()
value = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', value)  # remove extra spaces
value = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\s]', '', value)  # remove non-alphanumeric characters
value = re.sub(r'(\b[ap]\w*\b)', 'private', value)  # replace proprietary with private
value = re.sub(r'(\bvoluntary\b)', 'non-profit', value)  # replace voluntary with non-profit
value = re.sub(r'\bgovernment\b', 'govt', value)  # replace Government with govt
value = re.sub(r'\bchurch\b', 'church', value)  # add church to the list of hospital types

# Ensure consistent representation of hospital ownership types
value = re.sub(r'private$', 'Private', value)  # capitalize private at the end
value = re.sub(r'non-profit$', 'Non-Profit', value)  # capitalize non-profit at the end
value = re.sub(r'govt$', 'Govt', value)  # capitalize govt at the end
value = re.sub(r'\bprivate\s+non-profit\b', 'Private Non-Profit', value)  # combine private and non-profit
value = re.sub(r'\bchurch\s+govt\b', 'Church Govt', value)  # combine church and govt

# Remove unnecessary hyphens and underscores
value = re.sub(r'_-+|_+', '_', value)
value = re.sub(r'_$', '', value)

# Ensure uniformity in hospital ownership types
value = re.sub(r'\bvoluntary_non-profit\b', 'Voluntary Non-Profit', value)
value = re.sub(r'\bvoluntarv\b', 'Voluntary', value)
value = re.sub(r'\bvoluntary_n_p_c\b', 'Voluntary Non-Profit Church', value)
value = re.sub(r'\bgovt_hospital_district_or_authority\b', 'Govt Hospital District or Authority', value)
return value
